excludedRationale.explanation: IRN_S_001 berada di Iran. Dua slot kuota Iran (maksimum 2 per negara) sudah ditempati IRN_S_075 dan IRN_S_065 dalam rencana terpilih, sehingga IRN_S_001 tidak dapat masuk di bawah kendala geografis tersebut. Baris alasan/skor khusus IRN_S_001 pada tab sumber yang dikecualikan tidak berhasil ditampilkan; saya tidak menyatakan peringkatnya atau bahwa kuota adalah satu-satunya faktor jika ada batas peringkat lain.
excludedRationale.corroboratingSourceRecord: Daftar kasus menampilkan IRN_S_001 · Iran (Islamic Republic of) · Oil and Gas; source-directory priority 74.7/80 · high and 129 plume records. Directory priority is not the allocation score.

steps: Opened Cases → Plan investigation capacity; planner showed capacity 10, maximum per country 2, all regions, all sectors, recurrence 50%.
Compared four plans; selected the weighted historical indicators plan and inspected its 10 selected source rows.
Explicitly activated the plan; UI confirmed 10 planned sources activated, 10 added, 0 removed.
Changed Investigation slots to 20. The active plan remained the 10-source weighted plan with active capacity 10; no replacement was activated.
Looked up IRN_S_001 through the local source search; confirmed country Iran and reviewed the selected Iran sources in the active plan.

Search cases fill and some off-screen navigation controls timed out; local global source search succeeded afterward.
limits: The active plan is a proposed allocation, not an assignment or human approval.
Historical MARS observations, score, notification/feedback fields, or a digest do not establish repair, physical mitigation, methane reduction, or emissions cessation.
